definitions: A method of vector quantization, originally from signal processing, that aims to partition n observations into k clusters in which each observation belongs to the cluster with the nearest mean (cluster centers or cluster centroid), serving as a prototype of the cluster.
An unsupervised machine learning algorithm used to group similar data points together.
examples: K-means clustering is widely used for data segmentation.
We applied K-means clustering to identify customer groups.
The results of K-means clustering showed distinct patterns.
